response.what_it_is: Collection of black plastic water tanks of various sizes stacked outdoors
visible_condition: New or unused stock wrapped in protective plastic film
Outdoor storage with minor dust exposure
hidden_risks: Exact capacity (litres) of the specific tank being purchased at the listed price is unclear
Wall thickness and material durability quality
Presence of internal manufacturing defects or UV degradation from outdoor storage
response.failure_mode: Mistaking a bulk inventory photo showing multiple tanks for a single specific tank price, or assuming all tanks shown are the same size/capacity.
